turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm finally doing it. Three months backpacking in Southeast Asia, starting in January.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Exciting! Thailand is the easiest place to land and find your feet, while Vietnam has amazing food but is a bit more hectic. Where do you want to start?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just a sec, I need to sort something out with my roommate. I'll say when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alex, the boot won't shut. What did you put in here?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just the tent, the cool box, and my folding chair.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Your folding chair is the size of a sofa.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It has a cup holder! It's essential.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can it go on the back seat at least?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Only if you sit on the roof.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Very funny. Pass me the bungee cords, I'll strap it to the rack.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Who used the last of the toilet paper?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. So, your first stop in January. Thailand or Vietnam?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thailand. I want an easy first week.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sensible. Spend a few days in Bangkok, then head north to Chiang Mai before the islands get busy.
